purpose: Cold-target Lean benchmarks for the symbolic semantics of the compiled R2 root marker and table packer
method: Before each measurement, only that target's generated .olean/.ilean/IR products were moved aside. Dependencies remained built. The target was then rebuilt under a transient no-swap systemd scope with /usr/bin/time -v inside the scope.
note: Both proofs are universally quantified inductions over symbolic prefixes. Specialization to the literal production counts does not construct List.range, enumerate candidates, or normalize either fold.
